description:
Chan-young, a ghost who survives by leeching small amounts of energy from other people’s “nests,” happens to obtain a Rebirth Brew—a drink said to grant new life for a short while. Excited, he downs the entire thing.

The next day, thanks to drinking it all, Chan-young suddenly finds himself with a real human body. Flustered, he asks Tae-yoon—the guy he was hanging out with the night before—for a place to stay. But Tae-yoon mistakes him for some beggar and coldly turns him away…

Will Chan-young be able to survive in Tae-yoon’s “nest” after all?!
